newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RAMS says to issue A$200 mln Series 2 Bonds.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RAMS says to issue A$200 mln Series 2 Bonds.

text.p: RAMS Mortgage Corp Ltd said on Wednesday it plans to issue a further A$200 million of its Series 2 Bonds on November 15.

RAMS said in a statement it expected the bonds to be allocated on November 12, according to Bankers Trust Australia, lead manager and co-placement agent. J.P. Morgan Australia Securities would act as co-placement agent.

The A Class (senior) tranches were expected to be rated AAA/Aaa by Standard & Poor's Corp and Moody's Investors Service and the B Class (junior) tranches rated AA- by Standard and Poor's, the non-bank mortgage lender said.
Bankers Trust executive vice president Ian Moore said the third issue would be issued at a premium, reflecting strong demand by investors.

RAMS director Robin Redfern said: "Despite aggressive competition in the sector, which has seen traditional mortgage lenders reduce their mortgage lending rates, our home loan origination levels have continued to grow strongly."
The third issue of Series 2 Bonds would be fully fungible with the $400 million already on issue, RAMS said.
